Class ElmTreeBuilder

java.lang.Object
network.ike.foundation.ike.elm.ElmTreeBuilder
public final class ElmTreeBuilder extends Object
Builds one of our trees from ElmNodes, driven by the catalog: a vertex per ELM node, properties for the plain values it holds, an argument vertex between a node and each node it holds, and a list reference where a position's items live in an ordered list semantic. The built tree is checked against the catalog before it is returned, so a tree that does not conform never exists.
